visible_text: マイクと画面の音を聞いています
OAuth だけ確認お願いします
決まったことやること
それでは 9 月 12 日に比しましょう

observation.happening: Real-time meeting recording interface with transcription. Dark control bar shows timestamp (04:21). Left panel shows meeting context with OAuth auth pending. Right panel displays transcript with timestamps, speaker names (田中, あなた), and dialogue. Bottom section shows AI-connected materials (File, Gmail, Drive).
observation.most_important: Meeting is actively recording with multi-source transcription (mic + screen). AI is parsing connected documents in parallel.
observation.next_action: Continue meeting participation, review transcript tabs, or manage connected materials.
anomalies: OAuth message appears twice on left panel (once in main section, once in materials list) - unclear if intentional
Left panel sections feel somewhat cramped compared to spacious right transcript area

35A8.why: Solid execution with clear information hierarchy and thoughtful two-panel layout. Recording state is obvious, materials integration is smart. However, design follows standard meeting UI patterns without distinctive visual moments. No flaws, but not breakthrough design.

visible_text: macOS を先に出すことに決めました
Windows はいつ出しますか

observation.happening: Meeting detail view breaking down a meeting into structured sections. Top shows meeting title with date/time. Three horizontal sections show counts: 1 decision item, 0 action items, 2 memos. Each section is expandable. Tab bar below offers different views: transcription, dictionary, related files, source. Transcript shows conversation between Sarah and Ken with timestamps. Right sidebar shows meeting metadata (today, <1min, 2 people).
observation.most_important: Meeting structure is visually scannable with clear quantification of decisions/actions/memos. Tab-based navigation lets user view different aspects of same meeting.
observation.next_action: Click tabs to view transcription, files, or source materials. Expand decision/action/memo sections.

366D.why: Excellent information architecture and state clarity. Meeting structure (decided/action/memo counts) is immediately graspable. Clean tab navigation and transcript layout. However, uses standard SaaS patterns for tabs, sections, and sidebar layout. Well-executed but not visually distinctive.

observation.happening: Modal dialog for configuring a new recording session. Modal is centered and overlays a dimmed background showing the home page beneath. Dialog titled '新しい録音' (new recording). Contains three settings: microphone selector (MacBook Microphone), screen audio toggle (enabled), template dropdown (meeting memo), save location dropdown (personal only), and project dropdown (none). Two buttons at bottom: red 'やめる' (cancel) and blue '記録を始める' (start recording).
observation.most_important: Modal provides clear configuration before recording starts. Settings are pre-populated with sensible defaults.
observation.next_action: Adjust settings if needed, then click start recording or cancel.
anomalies: The background page is visible but slightly too prominent despite dimming - could cause distraction

48F8.why: Well-crafted modal with good spatial hierarchy and calm presentation. Settings are clearly organized with appropriate control types. However, follows standard modal dialog pattern. No distinctive design choices, but execution is solid and UX is clear.

visible_text: 週次ブリーフィングを作る
Q3 Proposal を読んでいます

observation.happening: AI agent (Astra) task execution interface with dark theme. Header shows task name '週次ブリーフィングを作る' with status '作業中' (working), timestamp 00:00, progress 50%. PLAN section lists 5 subtasks with status indicators: checkmarks (✓) for Calendar and Gmail (complete), solid bullet (●) for Notion (in progress), empty circles (○) for Web and Briefing (pending). Each task shows relevant context. CONTEXT section at bottom shows loaded information source (Notion, selected text, previous screen). Red 'stop' and white 'continue on work screen' buttons.
observation.most_important: Multi-level task breakdown showing agent's plan and progress across multiple substeps with status indicators. Dense information display appropriate for agent monitoring.
observation.next_action: Stop agent or continue on work screen to manage details.
anomalies: Progress percentage (50%) shown but unclear how subtasks map to it - no visual progress bar
Dense information layout might be hard to scan at a glance despite good status indicators

4D35.why: Thoughtful agent task interface with good status indicators (✓ ● ○) and context display. Information-dense but intentional. However, progress calculation is opaque (50% without visual representation), and dark theme combined with density reduces 'calmness'. Design is somewhat distinctive for agent interfaces but not exceptional in execution.

visible_text: 前回の設定でその場で続き始めます
予定から録音を始める
カレンダーの許可が必要です
\Space でここからでも始められます

observation.happening: Home screen empty state with onboarding information. Large greeting '何を終わらせますか？' (what do you want to finish?). Three main call-to-action sections: 1) Start recording with explanation, 2) Upcoming schedule (awaiting calendar permission), 3) Empty state message. Below is 'Getting started' section with 3 bullet points explaining core workflow. Layout is vertically stacked with significant white space between sections.
observation.most_important: Clear value proposition and onboarding path. User knows three possible first actions (start recording, grant calendar access, or learn). Messaging is welcoming and non-threatening.
observation.next_action: Grant calendar permission, start recording from scratch, or read getting started guide.
anomalies: '何を終わらせますか？' (what to finish) seems slightly disconnected from '録音を始める' (start recording) - terminology mismatch though likely intentional
Redundant messaging between top CTA and bottom keyboard shortcut hint both suggesting recording start
Very spacious layout may feel underutilized for some users

51ED.why: Excellent empty state design with strong clarity and welcoming calmness. Information is well-organized and scanning is effortless. However, messaging contains some redundancy, and the design follows standard onboarding patterns. Not distinctive, but execution is thoughtful.

visible_text: 実行中の仕事はありません
UI を閉じても走り続けます
Active / Waiting / Done で状態を追う

observation.happening: Agents task queue view showing empty state. Two tabs at top: Tasks and Agents (Agents selected, shown in blue). Filter buttons below: Active (selected), Waiting, Done, Failed, All. Main content shows empty state message '実行中の仕事はありません' (no active work) with explanation that jobs continue in background. Blue 'Task Dock を開く' (open Task Dock) button. Bottom section shows 'What you can do' with 3 bullet points explaining available actions.
observation.most_important: Clear empty state that educates user about agent capabilities (background execution) rather than just showing blank space. Primary action (Task Dock) is obvious.
observation.next_action: Open Task Dock, return to Tasks tab, or create new work.
anomalies: Filter bar (Active, Waiting, Done, Failed, All) is shown even in empty state - slightly odd UX pattern

5214.why: Good empty state design with helpful explanation of agent persistence. Calm and spacious. However, the filter bar presence in empty state is slightly odd UX, and design is quite standard. Less distinctive than other screens in the product.
